reuse.why: Builds on the existing WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay abstraction and routes every existing caller plus the new handler through it, but getNextDate filters weekend days itself instead of using the rule's daily branch.

duplication.why: The daily skip is decided both inside applyWeekendRule and again in getNextDate's isNonWorkingDay filter, and the config-to-WeekendRule mapping is written out twice in schedules/app.ts.

placement.why: Holiday matching, the holiday-aware move and the daily drop live in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing rule; only the getNextDate special case leaks the rule into occurrence selection.

scope.why: Changes cover the four steps plus tests and release notes; the import reorder is the only incidental edit.

maintainability.why: One WeekendRule type now carries frequency and holidays and all paths pass them, though the nullable return and getNextDate's separate daily handling add some subtlety.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate: filters occurrences with isNonWorkingDay for daily schedules and calls applyWeekendRule with skipWeekend forced off (!skipsWeekendDays) instead of relying on applyWeekendRule's daily branch.

disguised_duplication.where: getNextDate's firstWeekday filter re-expresses applyWeekendRule's 'daily + non-working day => drop' as an occurrence filter plus a disabled skipWeekend flag.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays; applyWeekendRule gains a frequency === 'daily' branch returning null; getNextDate bypasses that branch with its own filter.
